paragraphs: I'm Vamsi — ECE grad who fell into computer vision, spent five years shipping production AI at a startup, filed a few patents along the way, and then went back to grad school to understand the theory behind what was working.

Currently doing an MS in Robotics at UMN, building drones that navigate without GPS and 3D reconstruction systems that run at scale. Turns out the coursework makes a lot more sense when you have production context.
passions: 3D vision — SLAM, Gaussian Splats, stereo depth
Edge AI — making big models run on tiny hardware
Physical AI — where software meets the real world
